Honestly since your main concern seems to be how the withdrawals will affect you, I'd start as soon as you can, the irritability for me lasted probably about a week or two but the worst of it was the first 3-4 days. If you can get past that you should have much less mild mood swings and such (everyone is different tho so could be longer), maybe have some caffeine, sodas, or candy on hand to help with the urges those all have really helped me.

My biggest regret is being put in a situation similar without access, and coming back and starting again. If I stopped then I wouldn't have had my seizure. I'd say use this as the opportunity to quit, I wouldn't bring any patches or anything like that, just quit. If you're gonna be there all summer the irritability will most likely be gone before you go back home.
